title: Top Audio Picks
raw_text: Sony WH-1000XM5 offers wireless listening, strong battery life, and active noise cancellation. Bose QuietComfort Ultra is a premium wireless option with noise cancellation and broad availability notes. Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless delivers battery life and USB-C charging. Premium pricing and availability vary by region.
